services.desc: Crystal singing bowls. Pure resonance. An hour of deep rest for your whole being. A sound bath is a full-body listening experience. You lie down while crystal singing bowls fill the room with layered frequencies - tones that slow the nervous system, quiet the mind, and guide the body into a state of deep, effortless rest. services.name: Teacher Training
services.desc: Study yoga the way it was meant to be passed down, in the living lineage of Krishnamacharya. Our trainings weave āsana, breath, philosophy, and the subtle body into one trauma-informed approach to teaching real people, not just leading poses. The first half of our 200-hour program, for practitioners who want to go deep before committing to full certification. You study what yoga truly is, its ethics and philosophy, the foundations of prāṇa and the breath, and trauma-informed practice, then continue to certification when you are ready.
